violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to apply for a RICFSM with RIDOH. Application was printed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2026

Chicken wings were observed held at 130 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Hot-holding unit was turned up, and chicken wings were re-heated to above 165 DF at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the bar and kitchen. Establishment is to obtain thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device. New Violation. Correct By: 10/02/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the storage closet area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment must register with Rhode Island. Application provided to establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2025

Sink & Surface cleaner solution was observed in excess of 1875 parts per million (ppm). A Sink & Surface sanitizer solution applied to food contact surfaces must be between 704-1875 ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/29/2024
An ice scoop was observed in poor repair. PIC voluntarily disposed of scoop at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/29/2024
The plumbing under a sink located in the bar area was in poor repair (leak observed). New Violation. Correct By: 03/14/2024
